Gibbs sampler for the stochastic frontier model

Source: R/RcppExports.R
gibbs_sf.Rd

Workhorse behind add_posterior_coefficients. Not intended to be called directly, since it performs no input checking.

gibbs_sf(
  y,
  X,
  g,
  n_units,
  b0,
  B0i,
  ssvs_idx,
  tau0,
  tau1,
  prob_prior,
  varsel,
  a_v,
  b_v,
  a_u,
  b_u,
  beta_init,
  sigma_v2_init,
  par_u_init,
  u_init,
  ineff,
  s,
  draws,
  burnin,
  thin,
  u_thin,
  verbose
)

Arguments

y

vector of observations on the dependent variable.

X

matrix of regressors.

g

zero-based integer vector mapping each observation to the unit that owns its inefficiency term.

n_units

number of distinct units in g.

b0

prior mean of the frontier coefficients.

B0i

prior precision matrix of the frontier coefficients.

ssvs_idx

zero-based positions of the coefficients placed under stochastic search variable selection; empty for no variable selection.

tau0

prior standard deviations of those coefficients when they are excluded from the frontier.

tau1

prior standard deviations of those coefficients when they are included.

prob_prior

prior inclusion probabilities of those coefficients.

varsel

0 for no variable selection, 1 for stochastic search variable selection and 2 for the Bayesian variable selection of Korobilis (2013).

a_v

shape of the gamma prior on the error precision.

b_v

rate of the gamma prior on the error precision.

a_u

shape of the gamma prior on the inefficiency parameter.

b_u

rate of the gamma prior on the inefficiency parameter. For ineff = 0 these refer to the precision of the half-normal distribution, for ineff = 1 to the exponential rate.

beta_init

starting values of the frontier coefficients.

sigma_v2_init

starting value of the error variance.

par_u_init

starting value of the inefficiency parameter, the scale for ineff = 0 and the rate for ineff = 1.

u_init

starting values of the inefficiency terms.

ineff

0 for half-normal, 1 for exponential inefficiency.

s

-1 for a production frontier, 1 for a cost frontier.

draws

number of retained iterations before thinning.

burnin

number of discarded iterations.

thin

thinning interval.

u_thin

0 not to store the augmented inefficiency draws, otherwise the interval at which the retained draws are stored.

verbose

how often to report progress; 0 for no reporting.

Value

A named list of draw matrices.
